metadata.methods_description: Participants performed a Sternberg task in which sets of Russian consonant letters (3, 6, 9, 12, or 15 items) were presented during an encoding phase (1500 ms), followed by a retention phase (2000 ms, blank screen), and a retrieval phase (1500 ms) during which a probe letter was shown. Participants indicated via button press whether the probe letter had appeared in the encoding set. Each trial was preceded by a 500-1000 ms fixation cross, and 200 trials were completed in total (40 per set-size block). Stimuli were presented and responses recorded using PsychoPy2. EEG triggers marked only the onset of stimulus presentation; retention and retrieval times were computed based on fixed trial timing.
